term: necessary ancestor versus actual concrete root ancestor
resolution: NecessaryAncestor retains actuality, concreteness, finite ancestry and modal necessity but imposes no no-incoming-ground condition. NecessaryRootAncestor adds no actual concrete predecessor at the selected world; even it is not all-world NecessarilyUnderived. Contingent-only foundation yields NecessaryAncestor only. The necessary-cycle control satisfies necessary ancestry and fails actual root ancestry, so the earlier stronger conclusion cannot be inherited when weakening foundation.
